Name*: MBO D3.3 RScript Data Formatting and analysis
Description: Workflow/ code is formatting the source data into a standardized formatted spreadsheet containing macrozoobenthos, fish, phytoplankton and environmental data from the four case studies in EU HORIZON project MARCO-BOLO Deliverable D3.3 of Task 3.3. The source data (input) can be either preformatted in the spreadsheet or in other formats depending on the data source. Output is the final formatted spreadsheet ready for further analysis. Second part of the workflow/code is taking those inputs and analysing them for various parameters (details provided with the code).

Pipeline converting human-editable per-class metadata CSVs into validated, schema.org-aligned JSON-LD for the MARCO-BOLO metadata catalog. Driven by make and run in Docker, so it executes locally or in CI. Validates CSV-W constraints, manual foreign key constraints and SHACL shapes before conversion.

Browser-based knowledge graph explorer for the MARCO-BOLO metadata catalog. Consumes the JSON-LD published by csv-to-json-ld and renders it as a filterable graph, with work package filtering, orphan detection for tasks and deliverables lacking recorded outputs, a coverage heatmap and GEXF export. Deployed at https://lab.marcobolo-project.eu/kg-explorer/. Forked from sdiggs/kg-explorer by Stephen C. Diggs.
